explanationReview.embeddingAT: Continuous embedding perturbation versus discrete text; CE/log-likelihood sign; Cauchy–Schwarz; frequency-weighted coordinate normalization with all vocabulary entries; fixed inner parameters, detached perturbation and trainable outer embedding graph; sequence-wide budget and padding/EOS conventions. explanationReview.freeLB: Fixed weights during K ascent points, averaged parameter gradients and one outer update; worked scalar trace changes the sign relative to final-point training; dropout masks held within the search. K passes are not cost-free.
explanationReview.smart: Both directions of the classification divergence; local smoothing distinct from the prediction-space proximal penalty; previous/EMA reference; one-input numerical optimum and explicit omission of the local term in that isolated program.
explanationReview.vat: Fixed clean distribution; D(0)=0 and zero first derivative; PSD Hessian, leading eigendirection and finite-difference power iteration; degenerate/zero directions and nonlinear limits. Complete masked embedding update separates inner probe derivatives from the outer parameter gradient.

Published IMDb numbers separated by initialization and label budget.
